name: xhtoken/spark-x2.6-1.7b
title: SGLang serves Spark-X2.6-1.7B from day 0
summary: SGLang added day-0 support for Spark-X2.6-1.7B, a compact on-device model with a controllable thinking budget of none, low, or high. It uses the same architecture as Spark-X2.5-1.7B, has less than half the parameters of Spark-X2.6-4B, and is aimed at coding, agent, and long-context use.

appearances.title: iFlytek Spark-X2.6-1.7B claims SWE-bench Verified 59.8, with day-0 SGLang support
appearances.summary: iFlytek released a 1.7B on-device sibling of its Spark-X2.6-4B. It reports SWE-bench Verified 59.8 (4B: 62.8) and tau2-bench 85.3 (4B: 86.9), both at high thinking, with a controllable thinking budget. Weights are on Hugging Face. SGLang shipped day-0 serving support.
